scope: Exploratory source-grounded simulator-action triage, not real fraud labels
priorExposure: Generator redesigned after the v1 failure analysis; new scenario seeds are not independent natural-fraud evidence or preregistration.
split: Inherited provider split; each patient assigned to earliest of six groups before sampling. Context filtered by the same complete-source assignment, including nonselected records.
labelSemantics: Truth records the simulator's deliberate action/intent. Labels are not classifier outputs, feature thresholds, provider PotentialFraud, or adjudicated natural fraud. Benign scenarios are assumed synthetic controls, not verified legitimate source cases.
availability: History becomes observable at its invoice/end-of-care date proxy, not admission. Equal/current/future dates excluded. Actual submission timestamps are unavailable; no temporal-generalization guarantee.
auditAmendment: After initial v2 pilot inspection, tightened replay invoice identity and renamed the unobservable case to actual simulated phantom billing rather than mere provider compromise. Same family cardinality, rates, features and tuning settings; no performance-driven relabeling.
hypothesis: Does contextual triage add useful scrutiny beyond rules without treating benign repeats/high costs as automatically fraudulent?
rival: Intent and clinical necessity remain unobserved; benign and malicious actions can have identical observable inputs. More history may add workload rather than discrimination.

promotion.decision: HOLD; no runtime context commitments or natural-fraud validation
promotion.primaryGate: No new superiority claim from a generator engineered after observing earlier results

cohorts.test: 12% action intervention, same declared generator as training
cohorts.test_severity: 12% intervention, larger attack AND benign severities
